For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Kumar Goutam, Advocate  For the State : Ms. Veena Kumari Jaiswal, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 19-10-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms. Veena Kumari Jaiswal, learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Jadiya P.S. Case No. 77 of 2022 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420, 413, 379 and 120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, the informant gave Rs. 2,10,000/- to the petitioner to purchase gold biscuit.
Thereafter, the accused persons took out Rs. 3,000/- from the pocket of the informant and the accused persons including the petitioner looted three mobiles from the informant.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

Nothing has been recovered from the conscious Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.68569 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 possession of the petitioner.
The petitioner is in jail since 14.09.2023.
5. Learned APP appearing for the State opposes the prayer for regular bail of the petitioner.
6. The petitioner is accused in serious cases of loot, cheating and NDPS Act.

9. The District Judge, Supaul is directed to expedite the trial of all the cases registered against the petitioner.
10. Let a copy of this order be communicated to the District Judge, Supaul for its compliance through FAX or e-mail forthwith.
